usages.explain: Often used to present a negative prediction in the sense of "in this situation," "under these conditions."

examples.content: これだと、彼に迷惑をかけるんだ。
examples.transcription: これだと、かれにめいわくをかけるんだ。
examples.mean: This will cause trouble for him.

examples.content: これだと、約束の場所に着くまでまだ1時間かかりそうだ。
examples.transcription: これだと、やくそくのばしょにつくまでまだ1じかんかかりそうだ。
examples.mean: At this rate, it will probably take another hour to reach the appointed place.

title: これだと => If/When (it) is this
